pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: External 7 to 36 V supply (e.g. 12 or 24 V). Never to the ESP32. Pin order varies

pins.name: GND
pins.notes: Connect to ESP32 GND too (common ground)

pins.name: VOUT
pins.notes: Set the span trimmer so 20 mA gives 3.3 V or less before connecting. To an ADC pin (prefer ADC1: GPIO 32 to 39)

pins.name: I+
pins.notes: Current loop in, from the transmitter

sources.title: HW-685 seller datasheet
sources.section: Supply 7 to 36 V; 0/4-20 mA in; 0-3.3 / 5 / 10 V out set by zero and span trimmers
